zero_required_opposition_stop.basis: Two independent 32-episode windows each had zero thumb-positive rows, zero required-opposition rows, and zero unsupported hold. The task implementation defines required contact as thumb plus an opposing finger and at least two contacting fingers; the contact and hold criteria are therefore not progressing toward the intended grasp.
zero_required_opposition_stop.terminology_caveat: Do not describe this as zero physical contact overall: generic contact_fraction was positive in 1/32 and 3/32 episodes in the first two windows, and in 63/869 episodes overall. Those contacts did not include the thumb and did not satisfy required opposition.

single_fixed_pose_change.basis: The sole targeted pose change was tested at bounded closure amplitudes 0.15 (smoke08) and 0.65 (smoke09). Both runs had zero finger/required contact, released support, and dropped the fruit; smoke09 had seven of eight required checks true and failed only real_contact_observed. No second pose/material/drive change or further training followed.
single_fixed_pose_change.next_evidence_needed: None for this stopped run. The candidate did not demonstrate real contact, so it is not a B pass and does not justify main training or goal acceptance.
